title: This Fingernail-Sized Jellyfish Sends 1 in 5 Victims to Intensive Care

scenes.text: A fingernail-sized jellyfish can land you in intensive care.
It's the Irukandji. Its see-through body is about the size of a fingernail.
Its tentacles can stretch up to a metre.
Twenty to thirty minutes after a sting, people feel pain, vomiting, and a feeling of impending doom.
About one in five victims ends up in intensive care with heart problems.

description:
The Irukandji jellyfish is about the size of a fingernail, but its sting can put people in intensive care.
Symptoms include vomiting and a feeling of impending doom.
Would you swim in the sea knowing this?
